title: The Swapped Starfish Stone
intro: At the aquarium gift shop, the prize glass starfish paperweight has been replaced with a cheap plastic copy before the big raffle.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: I only came to buy a postcard, honest!

suspects.name: Ruth
suspects.line: At my age, I sit down and admire the sea turtles.

suspects.name: Oskar
suspects.line: I was counting the sharks. Ask the guide.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: Glass paperweights? Never heard of them.

suspects.name: Teo
suspects.line: I was just looking at the jellyfish. Really.

clues.text: Sandal prints are everywhere near the door, but none of them lead toward the glass case. Whoever wore sandals was only admiring the seashells.
A muddy footprint shows rain boots, the kind with a yellow stripe along the heel. Someone tracked in puddle water before the shelves were touched.
A dropped strap sits on the stool, and the bulky case still hanging from it is clearly a camera bag. Its owner was snapping photos of the tank corals.
The register log shows someone last paid for a keychain at the gift counter. The clerk swears the shopper was still hovering there afterward, a little too casually.
